$comment: What the positive-dialect pilot cost, in the unit this deployment bills in: hours of
EXISTENCE. The honest figure here is ZERO MARGINAL DEPLOYMENT HOURS, and that needs saying
plainly rather than being left to be inferred from a small number.
The deployment qwen--qwen-image-2512 was already running and already billing when this run
started, and it still is: candidates/qwen-image-2512/DEPLOYMENT.json records that it could
not be torn down from here and names the manual action needed. So this pilot did not create
a deployment, did not warm one, and did not extend one — it used minutes of a window that
was open regardless. The fifteen generations across all three repositories took 1.7 minutes
of wall clock end to end.
That is a real cost fact and it cuts BOTH ways, so it must not be quoted as 'the experiment
was free'. It was free only because a deployment nobody could delete was already burning.
Phase 2 — 233 assets in this dialect — would have been the same arithmetic only if the
endpoint happened to still be up; the honest planning figure for it is a fresh deployment's
provisioning plus warming plus roughly 45 minutes of generation, per COMPARISON.md section 6.
hoursBasis: observed working window only, first to last successful generation across all three sets. MARGINAL hours over a deployment that was already running and already billing for the literal-dialect run; it is not an additional deployment and did not extend the lifetime of the existing one.

teardown.state: SHARED WITH qwen-image-2512 — SEE THAT SET'S DEPLOYMENT.json
why: One deployment, two provider ids. Deleting it ends both sets' billing at once and neither
waits for the other. The manual action and the three ARM routes that fail to reach it are
recorded once, in candidates/qwen-image-2512/DEPLOYMENT.json, rather than twice here.
